input_path_contract: Absolute component walk, no dot/dotdot or symlinks; stable regular fd, exact size and SHA; consume the same verified buffer.

exit_codes.2: INPUT_ERROR or INCOMPLETE or output failure

initialization: randReset(0), randSeed(1), four reset-high cycles then four released idle cycles, verified empty actual debt/Matrix counters; no internal state forcing.
ram: One global external transaction. Normal memory.valid is rejected. Burst request has frozen 1x64B length, echoes captured full tag and last=1, reads only fixed N0/Wq payload. Write ng0 only: row-order 128 descriptors of 10x64B; exact LAST and byte coverage; typed response only after all data commits. No iDMA or AXI is instantiated at the external boundary.
boundary: Four exact window requests, three matching successful partial terminals (ng0 p0,p1 and ng160 p0), each physical Matrix count/done retired, ng0 true sum/drain with 128 typed write responses/81920 committed bytes, then first ng160 p1 accepted Matrix step. Expected wide12801/slice102408 is a corroborating counter, not sole proof.
failure_order: Real settled high resetRequired/runtime-stop gates precede current-edge software ledger mutation; validation uses a provisional ledger and commits after all RAM checks. HIGH_EVAL_POST_SOFTWARE_PREVIOUS_EDGE explicitly excludes the failing high edge from software ledger.
output: Bounded scalar JSONL only, stdout. No arrays/private paths/exception strings/raw inputs. Current RTL scalars and software counts are distinct. On normal target stop, job is deliberately still live and no full terminal or ACK1 is claimed.
caller_qualification: Caller must verify 196 ports and all 95 exact generated observation member widths, fixed sources/tools/dependencies, phase exits and cleanup. Production manifest alone does not qualify execution.
